Short Project Description: Located in San Jose del Monte, Altaraza is Bulacan’s first master-planned township, offering commercial lots that serve as the primary business district for the rising Northeast Manila corridor.
Long Project Description: Altaraza Urban Hub transforms San Jose del Monte into Bulacan’s newest growth center, capitalizing on the upcoming MRT-7 and Quirino Highway expansion. The commercial district is designed to capture the heavy foot traffic of this 105-hectare estate, serving as the central marketplace for the residential villages of Avida, Amaia, and Alveo that anchor the community.

Short Project Description: Alveo Financial Tower is the only office building currently for sale on Ayala Avenue, offering a rare opportunity to own a LEED-certified headquarters at the very center of the Makati CBD.
Long Project Description: Rising 49 storeys on Ayala Avenue, Alveo Financial Tower (formerly the JAKA Tower) is the only office development for sale on the country’s most prestigious corporate strip. With 363 units and a LEED certification, it features a signature glass façade, 19 high-speed elevators, and a premium "corporate alley" location that puts your business within walking distance of the Makati Medical Center and Ayala North Exchange.

Short Project Description: A-Block is the true Central Business District of Alviera, featuring a limited collection of 12 prime lots situated right next to the Country Club and the estate’s main greenbelt.
Long Project Description: A-Block represents the premium core of the 1,800-hectare Alviera estate, offering just 12 exclusive commercial lots that function as the "High Street" of Porac. Unlike the East district, A-Block is designed for corporate headquarters and high-end retail, boasting direct walkable access to the Alviera Country Club and the pedestrian-friendly green corridors that define the estate’s center.

Short Project Description: Alviera East Commercial is a 20-lot district positioned near the estate’s industrial park and Holy Angel University, making it the ideal hub for support businesses and student-focused services.
Long Project Description: Situated in Porac, Pampanga, Alviera East Commercial is strategically zoned to service the heavy daily traffic from the Alviera Industrial Park and the Holy Angel University campus. These commercial lots are distinct from the main CBD, specifically targeting businesses that need immediate access to the estate’s growing workforce and student population.

Short Project Description: Anvaya Cove is Ayala Land Premier premier seaside leisure community in Morong, Bataan, offering prime residential lots and exclusive beach and golf club amenities.
Long Project Description: Anvaya Cove is Ayala Land Premier first seaside leisure community, located in Morong, Bataan. Situated between the Silanguin mountain range and the West Philippine Sea, it spans 470 hectares of tropical landscape, integrating luxury residential lots, a world-class 18-hole golf course, and an exclusive beach club.
Description (Card Text): Nestled along the pristine coastline of Morong, Bataan, Anvaya Cove by Ayala Land Premier offers luxurious seaside living with world-class beach and golf club facilities.

Short Project Description: Arbor Lanes is a low-density, resort-style condo in Arca South that integrates nature into every level, featuring garden terraces and tree-lined voids.
Long Project Description: Located in the quietest corner of Arca South, Arbor Lanes is a five-block mid-rise development that prioritizes privacy and ventilation over maximizing unit count. The buildings feature garden terraces pockets of greenery on various floors that break up the facade and create a living-in-a-park feel.
Description (Card Text): Nestled in the vibrant heart of Arca South, Taguig City, Arbor Lanes offers refined resort-style condo living amidst lush greenery and open spaces.

Short Project Description: Dubbed the "Next BGC," Arca South is a 74-hectare estate in Taguig that serves as the southern gateway to Metro Manila, with commercial lots directly connected to the Skyway and the upcoming Taguig Integrated Terminal Exchange.
Long Project Description: Arca South is the last massive CBD build-out in Taguig, transforming the former FTI complex into a low-density business district that mirrors BGC’s lifestyle but with better connectivity to the south. The commercial lots here are high-value assets designed for headquarters and regional offices, benefiting from infrastructure like the Skyway off-ramp and the future Metro Manila Subway station that will be located within the estate.

Short Project Description: Areza Phase 1 establishes the new downtown of Lipa City, offering commercial lots that serve as the distinct gateway to this 92-hectare estate along the STAR Tollway.
Long Project Description: Positioned as the new City Center of Lipa, Areza Phase 1 offers larger commercial cuts designed to host the regional HQs and civic institutions that will anchor the estate. Located just 100 meters from the Balete Exit of the STAR Tollway, this district captures the immediate volume of traffic entering Lipa, making it the most visible commercial address in Batangas.

Short Project Description: Areza Phase 2 introduces "Shophouse" lots to the estate, creating a vibrant, pedestrian-focused retail row adjacent to the 1.6-hectare Central Park and City Hall.
Long Project Description: While Phase 1 focuses on larger corporate lots, Phase 2 is designed for vibrancy and lifestyle, offering specialized shophouse lots that encourage ground-floor retail with upper-level offices or residences. This phase sits directly next to the Areza Central Park and the new Lipa City Hall, guaranteeing a steady flow of government-related and leisure foot traffic.

Short Project Description: Ascenda is Ayala Land’s first estate in the Davao region (Toril), with commercial lots anchoring a 65-hectare town center that serves as the "Southern Gateway" to Davao City.
Long Project Description: Located in Marapangi, Toril, Ascenda Commercial offers the first-mover advantage in Ayala Land’s 204-hectare mixed-use project in Davao. These lots are positioned to become the primary trade area for the southern Davao corridor, featuring a 65-hectare town center and an Eco Park that will service the neighboring residential subdivisions and the bypass road traffic.

Short Project Description: Ayala Greenfield Estates is a 350-hectare hillside residential community in Calamba, Laguna, offering panoramic views of Mount Makiling, Laguna de Bay, and Manila skyline.
Long Project Description: Ayala Greenfield Estates is a signature luxury residential community in Calamba, Laguna, nestled on the slopes of Mount Makiling. It features an exclusive 18-hole championship golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones II, multi-tiered clubhouses, and magnificent natural elevation.
Description (Card Text): Positioned on the scenic slopes of Mount Makiling in Calamba, Laguna, Ayala Greenfield Estates offers luxury hillside living with a championship golf course.

Short Project Description: Ayala Westgrove Heights is an established, 400-hectare luxury village known for its rolling terrain, massive mango orchards, and high elevation.
Long Project Description: Often called the Ayala Alabang of the South, Ayala Westgrove Heights is a mature, 400-hectare village that utilizes the natural rolling terrain of Silang to create unique, non-uniform lots with premium views. Anchored by three clubhouses and native mango groves.
Description (Card Text): Gracefully situated in Silang, Cavite, Ayala Westgrove Heights offers refined living in a sprawling, low-density sanctuary surrounded by orchards and rolling hills.

Short Project Description: Broadfield is a 120-hectare district in Biñan, Laguna, designed as the "BGC of the South," offering massive commercial cuts for developers and companies looking for flexible FAR (Floor Area Ratio) in the CALAX corridor.
Long Project Description: Broadfield is not just a commercial strip; it is a massive 120-hectare district in Biñan designed to handle high-density mixed-use developments similar to BGC. With 66% of the estate allocated for commercial and mixed-use purposes, these lots offer high Floor Area Ratios (FAR), making them the only option in the south for developers who want to build vertical corporate or residential towers near DLSU and the CALAX.

Short Project Description: Ciela at Aera Heights is Ayala Land Premier flagship estate in Carmona, Cavite, perched on elevated ridge lands with sweeping views of the surrounding countryside.
Long Project Description: Ciela is the pioneer residential enclave within Aera Heights, a 1,000-hectare master-planned estate in Carmona, Cavite. Perched on rolling ridge terrain at high elevation, Ciela provides expansive estate lots integrated with greenways, parks, and climate-conscious landscape architecture.
Description (Card Text): Perched high on the rolling hills of Carmona, Cavite, Ciela at Aera Heights by Ayala Land Premier presents an exclusive elevated estate living experience.

Short Project Description: Circuit Makati is the city’s premier entertainment district, offering high-value commercial lots for hotels and headquarters within a 21-hectare estate that hosts the Samsung Performing Arts Theater.
Long Project Description: Built on the former Santa Ana Racetrack, Circuit Makati is a 21-hectare redevelopment that functions as Makati’s arts and entertainment node. The commercial lots here are scarce and highly specialized, designed for businesses that thrive on the "24/7" energy of the district, sitting alongside regional draws like the Circuit Mall, the Samsung Performing Arts Theater, and the Globe Circuit Event Grounds.

Short Project Description: Cloverleaf is an 11-hectare "pocket urban district" that serves as the strategic gateway to the north, offering direct connections to NLEX, EDSA, and the LRT-1 Balintawak Station.
Long Project Description: Positioned at the critical junction of EDSA and A. Bonifacio Avenue, Cloverleaf transforms the former textile mill site into a compact, highly efficient mixed-use estate. It is designed to solve the congestion of Balintawak by providing a planned urban environment with its own mall, hospital, and residential towers (Avida and Alveo’s Sentrove) connected directly to the Skyway Stage 3 off-ramp. It functions as the ultimate "connection point" for those who need to straddle the boundary between Metro Manila and Northern Luzon.

Short Project Description: Crescent Grove is an exclusive low-density residential enclave in Imus, Cavite, offering spacious estate lots within an intimately planned neighborhood.
Long Project Description: Crescent Grove is a refined residential development by Ayala Land Premier located in Imus, Cavite. Designed around central park corridors and quiet residential cul-de-sacs, it provides homeowners with breathable suburban space and swift access to Metro Manila via major expressways.
Description (Card Text): Situated in Imus, Cavite, Crescent Grove offers a tranquil low-density residential sanctuary surrounded by central parks and lush green corridors.

Short Project Description: Cresendo Phase 3 offers commercial lots in Tarlac’s first master-planned downtown, positioned directly beside the 32-hectare Industrial Park to capture the estate’s daily workforce traffic.
Long Project Description: Phase 3 of the Cresendo Downtown district is designed to service the immediate needs of the estate's industrial and educational locators, including the Don Bosco Technical Institute. These commercial lots function as the primary retail and service support for the 290-hectare estate, capturing the captured market of the industrial park workers and the future residents of the residential enclaves. It is the "shovel-ready" investment for businesses looking to establish a foothold in Tarlac City's modernized urban core.

Short Project Description: Crossroads is Bulacan’s upcoming 83-hectare industrial and commercial node, where Phase 1 and 2 lots are strategically zoned to serve the high-volume logistics and SME traffic from the Plaridel Bypass Road.
Long Project Description: Situated at the intersection of the Plaridel Bypass and the access road to the NLEX Balagtas Exit, Crossroads is a "drop-off" point for commerce in Bulacan. Phase 1 and 2 commercial lots are designed for "shophouse" style usage or mid-sized headquarters, catering to the supply chain businesses and service providers that support the region's growing industrial sector. This is not a lifestyle mall; it is a functional trade district built to capitalize on the heavy cargo and commuter volume moving through the bypass.

Short Project Description: Enara is an exclusive residential community in Canlubang, Calamba, Laguna, designed around expansive natural parks and mountain vistas.
Long Project Description: Enara by Ayala Land Premier is situated in Sitio Buntog, Brgy. Canlubang, Calamba, Laguna. Spanning generous lot cuts amidst preserved tree canopies and greenways, Enara combines country estate privacy with modern infrastructure and proximity to Nuvali.
Description (Card Text): Nestled in Canlubang, Calamba, Laguna, Enara by Ayala Land Premier provides a peaceful countryside estate setting framed by mountain views.

Short Project Description: Evo City’s South and West Districts are the high-value commercial engines of this 200-hectare estate, offering high-FAR lots directly connected to the future CALAX interchange and Centennial Road.
Long Project Description: Evo City is aggressively positioned as the "CBD of Cavite," and the South and West districts represent its prime commercial inventory. These lots are zoned for high-density mixed-use development, allowing for vertical corporate towers and hotels that will benefit from the estate’s superior connectivity—literally minutes away from MOA via Cavitex and connected to the rest of the south via CALAX. The West District, in particular, anchors the future Ayala Mall and the Technohub, making it the most premium address for headquarters in the province.

Short Project Description: Gardencourt Residences is the luxury centerpiece of Arca South, offering all-suite units with private elevator access and views of the central park.
Long Project Description: Gardencourt Residences brings the Ayala Land Premier standard to Arca South, featuring a fan-shaped layout that ensures privacy and maximum cross-ventilation. Units feature sky villas and private balconies overlooking the Arca Main Street and central parkways.
Description (Card Text): Located in Arca South, Taguig City, Gardencourt Residences delivers an exclusive parkside vertical living experience with private lobbies and expansive suites.

Short Project Description: Gatewalk Central is Mandaue’s new 17-hectare lifestyle core, with commercial lots surrounding a future Ayala Mall and office towers, designed to be the pedestrian-friendly alternative to the congested A.S. Fortuna corridor.
Long Project Description: Jointly developed with AboitizLand, Gatewalk Central solves Mandaue’s lack of a consolidated CBD by creating a fully integrated "superblock." The commercial lots here are scarce and highly valued, positioned to benefit from the foot traffic of the upcoming regional mall and the estate's BPO towers. It features a 30-meter wide pedestrian street—the "High Street" of Mandaue—creating a walkable retail environment that is currently non-existent in the area.

Short Project Description: Lanewood Hills is a highly exclusive, low-density neighborhood in Silang, Cavite, nestled between rolling hills and lush green spaces.
Long Project Description: Co-developed with Cathay Land, Lanewood Hills in Silang, Cavite, is a low-density sanctuary of only 200+ lots. Set against a gently undulating landscape, lots are oriented to maximize breeze, natural light, and green views.
Description (Card Text): Peacefully situated in Silang, Cavite, Lanewood Hills by Ayala Land Premier offers intimate hillside estate lots surrounded by pristine nature.

Short Project Description: Rising 65 storeys along Dela Rosa Street, Laurean Residences is a low-density sanctuary (4 to 9 units per floor) that functions as an exclusive "in-city club," dedicating over half a hectare to amenities while anchoring the new Dela Rosa Gardens district.
Long Project Description: Laurean Residences redefines the Makati skyline as the residential anchor of Dela Rosa Gardens, a new district connecting the Ayala Triangle and Greenbelt via the Emerald Network of elevated walkways. Designed by Joyce Wang Studio, this 65-storey tower offers just 388 units (ranging from 70sqm suites to 402sqm bi-levels) and dedicates over 50% of its footprint to resort-grade amenities, including private dining halls, wellness spas, and sky terraces. It is the only address in the CBD that combines the privacy of a low-density vertical estate with immediate, sheltered pedestrian access to the city’s financial core.

Short Project Description: Lio Sitio Aplaya offers rare commercial lots within the Lio Tourism Estate, allowing private investors to build boutique hotels or dining concepts just a short walk from the Lio Beach shoreline.
Long Project Description: Lio Sitio Aplaya is the commercial precinct of the 325-hectare Lio Tourism Estate, the only master-planned eco-tourism township in El Nido. Unlike the chaotic town proper, this district is strictly zoned and managed, ensuring sustainability and high architectural standards. These lots are specifically designed for bed-and-breakfasts, dive shops, or specialty restaurants that want to capture the premium tourist market flying directly into the Lio Airport, bypassing the long commute from Puerto Princesa.

Short Project Description: Metro Nuvali is the South’s premier 200-hectare Central Business District, integrating dynamic commercial, civic, and lifestyle hubs into the heart of the sustainable Nuvali estate.
Long Project Description: Rising as the definitive commercial capital of CALABARZON, Metro Nuvali transforms 200 hectares of the estate into a connected urban core divided into the Lakeside, Central, and Civic districts. Anchored by the Santa Rosa Civic Complex and expanded Ayala Malls, this pedestrian-friendly hub blends enterprise with nature through dedicated green corridors and open parks. With direct links to SLEX and CALAX, it establishes a sophisticated business environment that rivals Metro Manila’s established CBDs.

Short Project Description: Miravera is Ayala Land Premier pioneer residential neighborhood in Altaraza, Bulacan, featuring rolling terrain and natural streams.
Long Project Description: Miravera is located in the master-planned Altaraza estate in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. It offers large lot cuts integrated into a natural landscape of ridges and waterways, servicing the growing northern Manila corridor.
Description (Card Text): Beautifully positioned in San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan, Miravera is an exclusive estate neighborhood integrated into Altaraza natural rolling landscape.

Short Project Description: The East and Central Blocs are the final commercial frontiers in Nuvali’s CBD, offering flexible lots for offices or schools right next to the busy Solenad retail strip and the Evotech district.
Long Project Description: Nuvali’s Central and East Blocs are not just "vacant lots"; they are the infill pieces of an already thriving CBD. The Central Bloc is positioned for smaller, boutique support businesses (banks, clinics, showrooms), while the East Bloc allows for larger corporate headquarters or educational institutions. Both districts benefit from the mature infrastructure of Nuvali—wide roads, established utilities, and a massive daily population of residents and office workers that is already present, not projected.

Short Project Description: Lakeside Evozone is the campus-type commercial district of Nuvali, designed specifically for BPO locators and offices that require a tranquil, park-like setting beside the lake.
Long Project Description: This is the operational heart of Nuvali’s office sector, distinct from the retail-heavy Solenad area. Lakeside Evozone offers commercial lots that are PEZA-registerable (subject to approval), catering to multinational companies that prioritize employee wellness. The district is fully built out with functional amenities, bike paths, and the iconic lake, providing a "Silicon Valley" style campus environment that aids in employee retention and productivity.

Short Project Description: As the first premier corporate tower in Vertis North, One Vertis Plaza offers a flagship Quezon City address with direct access to Vertis Gardens.
Long Project Description: One Vertis Plaza is a 43-storey all-glass corporate tower positioning businesses at the center of the 45-hectare Vertis North CBD in Quezon City. Features a grand double-volume lobby and direct integration with Vertis Gardens.
Description (Card Text): Located in Vertis North, Quezon City, One Vertis Plaza is a landmark premier corporate headquarters tower directly overlooking the estate central park.

Short Project Description: Park Central Towers is an iconic ultra-luxury residential skyscraper located at the corner of Paseo de Roxas and Makati Avenue.
Long Project Description: Rising at the prominent corner of Paseo de Roxas and Makati Avenue, Park Central Towers redefines the Makati skyline. Featuring double-volume sky villas, private elevators, and direct access to luxury retail hubs.
Description (Card Text): Standing at the prominent intersection of Paseo de Roxas and Makati Avenue, Park Central Towers represents the pinnacle of luxury living in Makati CBD.

Short Project Description: Park Villas is an ultra-exclusive collection of 45 full-floor residential villas rising beside Ayala Triangle Gardens in Makati City.
Long Project Description: Park Villas is a rare expression of vertical estate luxury on Makati Avenue. With only 45 single-unit floor residences, each villa offers 360-degree views, bespoke finishes, and immediate access to Ayala Triangle Gardens.
Description (Card Text): Positioned along Makati Avenue across Ayala Triangle Gardens, Park Villas offers 45 full-floor private residences crafted for ultimate luxury and discretion.

Short Project Description: Parklinks Towers offer low-density luxury units with direct access to the River Esplanade and Parklinks Mall bridging QC and Pasig.
Long Project Description: Anchoring the greenest urban estate along C-5, Parklinks North and South Towers provide direct, exclusive access to the River Esplanade. Offering expansive residences (70sqm to 310sqm) with floor-to-ceiling glass capturing views of the Antipolo mountains.
Description (Card Text): Located along the C-5 corridor in Quezon City and Pasig, Parklinks Towers deliver low-density luxury living connected to expansive estate parks.

Short Project Description: Seagrove is a 14-hectare resort-commercial complex in Mactan featuring a "Seagrove Lagoon" and commercial lots designated for dining and retail concepts that support the island's high-end resort row.
Long Project Description: Positioned along the Punta Engaño resort corridor (near Shangri-La and Movenpick), Seagrove is Mactan’s first eco-fun destination. The commercial lots here are not for generic offices; they are curated for lifestyle and tourism-support businesses—think al fresco dining, dive shops, or souvenir boutiques—that anchor the estate’s central lagoon and mangrove forest. It effectively functions as the "town center" for the tourists and guests of the nearby luxury hotels.

Short Project Description: Located in the 26-hectare waterside estate at SRP, these blocks are prime commercial cuts positioned to be the corporate headquarters of the Visayas, sitting adjacent to the SM Arena and Convention Center.
Long Project Description: South Coast City is the result of a massive consortium between Ayala Land and SM Prime, designed to be the entertainment and business capital of Cebu. Block 2 and Block 5 commercial lots offer the highest visibility, situated near the district’s main park and the pedestrian bridgeway connecting to the seawall. These are premium, high-density lots meant for developers or corporations who need to be at the center of the action in Cebu’s next decade of growth.

Description (Card Text): Situated within the active Vermosa estate in Cavite, The Courtyards by Ayala Land Premier offers grand suburban lots surrounded by green corridors.

Short Project Description: The Junction Place acts as a commercial relief valve for Novaliches, offering organized, flood-free commercial lots in a district dominated by congestion, anchored by a Waltermart and a transport terminal.
Long Project Description: The Junction Place is an 11-hectare "pocket urban center" inserted into the dense residential fabric of Novaliches. It solves the area's two biggest problems: lack of organized commercial space and traffic. The commercial lots here are designed for community support businesses—groceries, clinics, learning centers, and logistics hubs—that serve the thousands of households within a 3km radius. It is a defensive, high-utility asset that thrives on the sheer density of its location.

Short Project Description: Vermosa splits its commercial offering into two distinct personalities. Midtown is the "Ayala Avenue" of the estate, featuring larger cuts for corporate towers and the regional mall, accessible via Daang Hari. Campus Town, on the other hand, is more granular and vibrant, offering smaller commercial lots (shophouse style) specifically targeted at businesses serving the student population and athletes—think hip cafes, co-working spaces, and boutique hostels. Both districts benefit from Vermosa's status as the premier sports and wellness destination in the south.

Vermosa Midtown is the commercial CBD of the estate, while Campus Town is a specialized "youth-centric" district designed for shophouses, dorms, and retail serving the De La Salle Zobel campus and Sports Hub.
Virendo is Ayala Land Premier signature residential estate in Toril, Davao City, overlooking Mount Apo and the Davao Gulf.
Long Project Description: Located in Marapangi, Toril, Davao City, Virendo is a 57-hectare low-density residential community. Framed by views of Mount Apo and the Davao Gulf, it offers generous estate lot cuts integrated into Davao southern expansion corridor.
Description (Card Text): Positioned in Toril, Davao City, Virendo by Ayala Land Premier delivers elevated hillside estate living with views of Mount Apo and Davao Gulf.
